posts.text: This is happening right now! The bold progressive badass Analilia Mejia is officially sworn in!

Good riddance to another one of Trump’s cruel, corrupt cabinet members. 

Once again, another woman has been ousted by Trump. It’s about time to clean house of the incompetent men too — I’m looking at Kash Patel and Pete Hegseth.

Congratulations to Seattle’s own Jane Don't for winning Miss Congeniality on this season of Drag Race!

You were incredible all season long and showcased the amazing LGBTQ+ artistry we have here in Seattle!
Countless trans people have already been forced out of the military because of Trump’s trans military ban. Attempting to kick out those remaining is a gross politicization of our military.

It’s incredibly suspicious that every time Trump is about to make an announcement about the Iran war, there are perfectly timed bets and futures trading.

This needs to be investigated immediately — anyone insider trading must be held accountable. theguardian.com/world/2026/a…
You want to talk about fraud? Look at the Department of Defense first.

Thank you to everyone who came out to our town hall last week!

Community is one of the most powerful tools we have right now — your questions and opinions inform my work every day. vashonbeachcomber.com/2026/0…

At least 88 corporations paid ZERO in income tax despite reporting $105 BILLION in profits. Meanwhile the average American paid $14.5% on their income. 

Our system is rigged to benefit billionaires. It’s time to fix it.

There is billions in confirmed fraud within the Department of Defense, yet Trump and Vought are going after health care, childcare, and nutrition assistance.

As Congress puts together the 2027 budget, we must fight back.
fortune.com/2026/04/16/trump…
Imagine if we invested in childcare and health care like we do in war and weapons.

In 2024, I secured $800K for Vashon Community Food Bank for their new food bank and community resource hub to serve more people in need. 

They are doing incredibly important work to provide for our neighbors as costs continue to rise, and I’m proud to support it.

RECAP: 6 weeks ago, the Strait of Hormuz was open. 
Today, after Trump's war of choice that caused 13 US troops dead, thousands of Iranian and Lebanese civilians dead, millions more displaced, $50 billion of US taxpayer dollars wasted, gas prices sky high--the Strait has reopened. Temporarily.   
Trump illegally caused death, destruction & higher prices for absolutely nothing.

Joel Connelly was an institution in Seattle journalism, with a career that spanned decades. He covered so much in his time, and it was always a joy to hear his stories from reporting over the years. 

He will be missed and my heart is with his family. seattletimes.com/seattle-new…

In the middle of the night, Republican leadership tried to jam through legislation that allows the government to spy on Americans without a warrant.

I voted NO. We need serious privacy reform to protect the American people.

End the fuel embargo. Lift the state sponsor of terrorism designation. Negotiate long-lasting stability for the people of Cuba.

PODCAST EPISODE 20: @Rep_Jackson and I recently went on a congressional delegation to Cuba, where we saw the impact of failed U.S. policies.

Watch to hear our full recap and how we should move forward: piped.video/watch?v=gGyDHO4t…

The Trump administration has cut LEGAL immigration 2.5x as much as undocumented immigration, which had already fallen before Trump took office.

We need to do everything we can to provide a glimmer of hope and protect the communities that are at risk right now.
